summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Patepic post-refactor (LIGHT theme, MongoDB-stored reviews, JWT admin, R2 uploads, real Resend). 17/17 pytest backend tests pass. All UI flows verified end-to-end: light theme, navbar/LIVE badge, reviews list/filters/sort/detail, tier list, about/guidelines, contact form (real Resend success), admin login + redirect protection, admin table with 8 rows, New review dialog, Edit dialog pre-fills correctly, Delete AlertDialog confirmation, R2 upload (PNG -> public URL reachable HTTP 200), and logout flow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:200 — resend.Emails.send is run via asyncio.to_thread which is correct; no blocking issue.

server.py:341 — CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins from env defaulting to '*' is a misconfiguration (browsers reject credentials with wildcard origin). Not breaking current flow since auth uses Bearer header not cookies, but consider explicit origins or set allow_credentials=False.
server.py:348 — Uses deprecated FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handler for forward compatibility.

server.py:311 — update_review filters out None values which prevents intentionally clearing optional string fields (verdict/cover_url) by setting them empty via API — minor UX issue if admin wants to delete a cover URL via JSON PUT.
Admin.jsx — All interactive elements have data-testid (good). Edit/Delete use icon-only buttons (Pencil/Trash2) with title attribute — accessible.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login — brute force possible. Playbook recommends 5-fail lockout.
seed_data_creation: 8 reviews pre-seeded in MongoDB by backend/seed_reviews.py. Test created/updated/deleted one TEST_Review_* via API (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All endpoints + UI verified working. Backend: 17 pytests cover health, public reviews (list/filter/sort/get/404), auth (login success/wrong-pwd/me unauth/me auth), admin CRUD (unauth + create→GET verify, update→GET verify, delete→GET 404), R2 upload (verifies URL reachable), and contact (Resend). Frontend: visited /, /reviews, /reviews/baldurs-gate-3, /tier-list, /about, /guidelines, /contact (form submitted, success shown), /admin (redirect protection works), /admin/login (login OK), admin dashboard (8 rows, New review dialog opens, Edit pre-fills BG3 data, Delete shows AlertDialog), logout via data-testid='nav-logout' (signs out and /admin redirects to login). Light theme confirmed: body bg rgb(244,248,252) = #f4f8fc. No dark navy backgrounds detected.
